text:
The March17,2026 motion would suspend the rules and pass H.R.4294 as amended, the whole MAWSAct purchasing/data/assessment package. It adds a blue-catfish pilot to the existing Chesapeake Bay NOAA framework, not a separate vote only on scientific estimates, a transport subsidy or private fishing revenue. The combined question retains its two-thirds threshold; House passage is not enactment or a program already operating.
Commerce through NOAA must use/co-ordinate the named existing programs to enter cooperative agreements with covered entities that purchase Chesapeake-watershed blue catfish from watermen or from seafood processors who bought that catch from watermen. Covered entities are pet-food, animal-feed or aquaculture-feed manufacturers/processors, not human-food recipients or every research partner. They must apply in the form/time/information determined by the Secretary. A waterman must certify watershed origin; a seafood processor must certify the specified purchase/origin chain. A covered entity must use awarded amounts for purchases at least at the Secretary-determined price per pound and may use no more than15percent for transport to manufacturing/processing facilities. The Secretary sets the minimum price considering market factors, available participant feedback and fillet/byproduct differentiation; the bill does not print a fixed dollar price or guarantee all fish will be purchased.
The scientific-data duties are substantive parts of the whole choice. Within180daysafterenactment the Secretary must seek a memorandum with eligible non-Federal partners to compile existing data and adjust their collection for abundance estimates and the named report information. Seeking the memorandum is not a guarantee of agreement or unilateral ownership of every partner's data. Partners are Maryland, Virginia and the specified expert research institutions; they are not automatically covered feed-purchasing entities. The existing1511d(b)framework already coordinates coastal/estuarine and fisheries research, stock assessment, data management, remote sensing and ecosystem work with peer-review/scientific-merit and reporting functions. The new pilot uses that framework; it does not create NOAA's first research or data authority.
The Secretary must develop and publish abundance estimates pursuant to the memorandum bySeptember30,2027and annually thereafter through fiscal2032. The two-year pilot begins on the first day of the fiscal year AFTER the LATER fiscal year of the first public abundance estimate and the required guidance. It is not simply two years after enactment, nor does issuing either prerequisite alone start it immediately. Guidance is due within1yearafterenactment with the specified workgroup/federal-agency consultation. Briefings start within90daysafterenactment and recur quarterly through pilot termination; the final report is due within180daysaftertermination. These distinct duties/clocks are not collapsed into one report or one fixed current launch date.
The report covers available population/biomass/size/diet/catch data, effects on other species/environment to the extent known, watermen's revenues/other catch, market and manufacturing/transport practices, continuation/expansion/invasive-species recommendations and missing-data needs. Its requested assessments are not proved causal effects, existing abundance figures or guaranteed ecological/market improvements. The Chesapeake watershed definition includes the Bay, the named six States' draining portions and DC; it is not every water body or every fish. The printed bill supplies no fixed new appropriation; this candidate does not certify available program balances, actual awards, current implementation, a fish price, profit, catch increase, biological improvement, transport facility or public-health outcome.
A Yea supports passing this whole cooperative-purchase/scientific-assessment/timing/report package; a Nay opposes it without establishing opposition to scientific research or a preferred alternative. Infrastructure/Technology membership is an UNACCEPTED candidate proposal based on the direct public scientific-data/assessment duties integrated with the existing NOAA research/technical framework. A competing boundary treats the whole action as ecological management and commercial-fisheries intervention. Independent source, whole-mandate and taxonomy review is required before acceptance or publication; no accepted methodology or domain expansion follows.
